A special bomb designed to destroy archdevan magic constructs.
Mix Test, Unlimited use.
Map showing the direction of the mana wave via the mana measuring device.
[Throwable] Explosive used for training. Can be used at the Tower Base against scarecrows.
[Throwable] A special bomb designed to destroy dementaliths. Use near a dementalith.
[Throwable] Good for knots and restraints.
[Throwable] Monster spawns randomly by probability.
Token carried by Mystic of the Scions of Lok.
Token carried by Sorcerer of the Scions of Lok.
Token carried by Warrior of the Scions of Lok.
[Usable] An instrument that combines Mystic's Token, Sorcerer's Token, and Warrior's Token.
Mysterious fragment containing Lok's energy
[Throwable] A dart used by swineherds to control piglings.
[Throwable] Used to purify the evil plaguing the unicorn Seravy.
Nearly incorporeal air energy used to activate the purifier. You can see a vortex in constant motion deep within.
[Usable] Inactive device for purifying blood magic. Will require a strong power source.
[Usable] Device for purifying the blood magic from the Thulsa's bloody tombstones. Must be in close proximity to use.
[Throwable] A sticky gel to cancel the curse on Kaidun's henchman, Ghufran.
[Throwable] Outer appearance means nothing. This brew will bear light on Kaidun's truth.
[Throwable] Used to entice the White Hart to follow you, instead of attacking you.
[Usable] Use this to provoke and call Shakazen who is hiding at Shakazen's Refuge.
Secret Letter to Thulsan forces
[Throwable] Very large, very dangerous bomb. Use only as directed. Do not eat.
Rubbing of the Ancient Headstone
A book from Goddess Mystel that contains information about ancient myths.
Part of a document held by Lok's cultists. The writings are encrypted.
[Usable] A magical device that can be used to decrypt ancient codes.
Decrypted Scion document.
Salting barrel.
Bland but readily available meat.
Coarse salt for preserving meat.
Meat preserved with salt lasts a lot longer without going bad.
Frogstongue Potion
Necroneutralizing Reagent to break Thulsa's imprisoning spell.
This item is no longer usable.
Often used as fencing.
Sharp metal scraps twisted into metal wire. Very useful for fences.
Wooden fence posts.
A report written by Whimnia.
Piece of leather with Lok's mark.
Used for making tracings of chiseled or textured stone.
A book that records the legend related to Shakan, the Beastlord.
Heroth's note to Siria.
A crate likely to contain plunder of the pirates. There also might be some secret information of the pirates.
Pendant worn by Adarak, who instigated chaos among the Giants. You must bring the pendant to Worlkir as proof of Adarak's death.
A sacred object made by combining various powerful magics. According to Mirak Bright, this sacred object can free the Giants.
[Usable item] A special bomb for destroying the dementaliths. Set this item near the dementalith to blow it up.
[Usable item] A dangerous bomb brought from Allemantheia to destroy the powerful dementaliths. Set this item near the dementalith to blow it up.
[Usable item] A scroll containing magic powerful enough to release the Wondrous Tomb Seal. If the magic of the scroll is used on the Sealing Stone...
It's a fragment gathered while inspecting the Resurrection Stone in the Temple of Dagon.
Mysterious potion made by Arcanist Klaon from herbs and Artful Gracebloom to clear to clear troubled minds.
This scroll is protected by magic.
Orders from Dakanius.
It bears the mark of Lok.
Records of the Scions of Lok.
A book written in some form of cipher.
Fragments of a destroyed dementalith.
The cold heart of the Countess. It's extremely cold. Seriously...don't lick it.
Red eye of the Count. It looks like it can still cast a spell on its beholder.
Draught made by Princess Arin using dewdrop buds and Rida's hair. Arin claims it's not dangerous...well, very dangerous.
Rida's letter for her little sister Arin.
Sedative made by Arin to get the Rebel Army under control. It looked as if she wanted the Rebel Army to die with this sedative.
A diary kept by a student of the Eldritch Academy.
These appears to be messages from the Scions of Lok.
Mattin's report from the Celestial Hills.
An old journal recorded by a miner.
An old hammer found inside of a crate. It doesn't look like it can be used as a weapon.
Old scissors found inside of a crate. They don't look like they can be used as a weapon.
A small bomb issued to blowup the weapon crates. It has a small destructive force, ideal for usage in caves.
This item is no longer usable.
A bomb meant to destroy Samael's Soul Stone in the Cultists' Refuge (Quest item).
This organic key seems to be an important part of Saleron's Sky Garden. Good thing you caught that caiman keybearer.
Samael's orders for Bruke.
Kinias's report on suspicious people in Cutthroat Harbor.
Korvin's report on suspicious people in Cutthroat Harbor.
Caton's report on suspicious people in Cutthroat Harbor.
Slawgesh's ledger.
Transaction ledger obtained from Slawgesh. It's encrypted so you can't read it.
A cipher carried by the Kazuur Syndicate. Perhaps it can decode their records.
A lance possessed by Kutmaschuk. Unlike the legendary weapon of a god that it is thought to be, it's fake and looks cheap.
Hair of the elin Princess Rida, who is in hiding at the moment.
An argon-created device found on the argonomorphed gula. What it does is unclear.
Portal token carried by Nurkrasid.
Portal token carried by Valursus.
Portal token carried by Masakrad.
Dazzling gem found on the dead bodies of Kaidun's soldiers.
A magic stone from the magical stone manufacturing device.
Magical ore mined in Fyrmount. It feels similar to lava. Prized in Castanica for its ability to generate power.
Belongings of miners.
Detrian's heirloom sword. You should return it to Hennika.
Small flute used to call upon the orcan cooperators. Only use at the secret meeting location.
Token left by General Kaidun, Fraya's lover.
An argon-created device found on the argonomorphed orcan. What it does is unclear.
Flame capturing Saleron's power. Only the power of a god can purify those who have been corrupted by the argons.
A note from Darekuur.
A key that can stop Killian's Necromancy Device.
Shana's report. Right-click to read.
Odorless white liquid used for very advanced alchemy. It can be used as a base to be mixed with Essence of Agony or Joy of Madness to create the Potion of Agony and Joy.
The agony of prisoners under torture captured in a bottle by magic.
The maniacal laughter of Killian's insane jesters captured in a red crystalline form. This strange gem makes the jesters laugh gleefully no matter what the situation is.
A potion that makes the victim feel both agony and joy. A terrible potion preferred by Killian's Torturers for inflicting emotional pain with their physical blows.
An admixture of agony, joy, and madness with a distingly evil aura. A fitting revenge to be used on the brutalest of torturers.
A key for accessing the true Throne of Nightmares.
A note from a Mysterium researcher.
An ancient treasure said to be able to reflect the determination of its beholder and transform it into power.
An ancient divine bottle that can hold Sikander's Holy Flame.
Detergent strengthened with magic for cleaning up various types of contamination.
It's very worn out with various forms of garbage on it. Can't really make out its original form.
A necklace worn by Mysterium members. There's a darkish-red blood stain on one corner.
A list of residents of Castanica snatched by the gulas. Might be worth reading.
A sedative that reduces the Vampirs' thirst for blood.
A device that detects lies.
Hard Naga skin stronger than steel. Can be sold at a good price to luxury buyers.
Chest full of gold looted by Naga Pirates.
Chest full of magical relics. Looks to be an offering to Dagon.
Blue jewel strongly infused with Dagon's power.
Key bestowed by Saleron to those who have passed the trial. Used to activate the Ancient Slate.
Key made from wyvern horn. Used to activate the Ancient Slate.
Key made from Dracoloth's scales. Used to activate the Ancient Slate.
Round ice stone resembling a pupil.
Round fire stone resembling a pupil.
Glacier fragment dug out from the ice cap in the Vale of Spires.

These smell like rotting meat, probably for good reason.
A baggage full of items the merchant sells.
A very tasty mushroom.
Hay that cows love.
Food sack that the townsfolk left behind when fleeing.
Easy to grow and full of nutrients, toruan is often the main food for poor people.
Basilisk Egg
An assortment of adornments and jewelry. Nothing looks especially valuable.
A heavily scuffed box with the federation seal. It looks like it might have fallen from a great height.
Ancient relics covered in esoteric markings. Found around the ruins near Leander's Outpost.
An amulet engraved with the name of a member of the first Expedition to the Island of Dawn.
A small pale fruit with a pungent aroma. Said to be the bane of Vampirs.
Flower that grows where Vampirs live. Toxic.
Fragments of an image. It will take a few pieces to puzzle together into a coherent picture.
This could belong to an extinct creature.
A nice land mine tip with a pretty fine finish.
A vial of vivid effervescent fluid. The smell is unbelievably bad.
This poor soul is beyond help. It seems that the body was eaten.
A petal gathered from golden pigweed plants. A primary ingredient of a rare healing medicine.
Antiques the pirates had plundered.
Items dropped by those fleeing from pirates.
Supplies for the expedition.
A hazevine flower, often used in medicine.
A weapons crate stolen from the first expedition by the pirates.
Massive relics once used by the Giants.
Daily work report kept by the Instructor Witches. May shed a clue on why the witches have gone insane.
Investigation data of the ruins of Tyboth, the ancient giants' city.
Stone slab with unknown inscriptions and illustrations. It's stored in a large jar.
A box that contains magic extracting tools.
Cool refreshing water is in the barrel.
The Derasa Clam lives only in the deep sea. Its shells are washed ashore by the waves.
Bitterly sour fruit from the fragrant roses. While few will brave the taste, botanists claim it is full of vitamins.
Focus on the scent to refresh your mind.
A relic that seems to be abandoned by Lok.
The remains of Lok Followers.
Junk Eustace claims are important relics, but are not lost, even though he sent you to go find them.
Supplies that are to be sent to the Essenian Garrison who are fighting to seize a fortress.
Delicate flowers that grow in snowfields. Ingredient in a soothing tea.
Ore swirling with titanic energy.
A medicinal herb that has a mysterious smell.
Suspicious document of unknown origin.
A cold dark mass with a strange palpable energy.
A relic inscribed with undecipherable characters.
Wood processed by lumbermen.
A flower that turns blood red when picked.
A twisty mushroom.
Stone with a slight hint of the temple's energy.
A dark blue berry with a nice tang.
Remains that look like bones from a villager.
Extremely hard, it is used for making cutting knives.
A debris that proves the tablet is destroyed.
Vines used for making traps.
It contains hunting weapons.
Fruit that Nagas enjoy. It is rare to find, making it hard to gather.
Found near Serpentis Isle, the stone contains five colors and is used for some unknown purpose. Prized by nagas.
Ore used by the ancient Giants.
Item left behind by the ancient Giants. Its usage is still unknown.
Tearroot grows in cold climates. It has a strong scent and has an anti-bacterial effect, making it useful for medicinal purposes.
These supplies should have been sent to the Advance Base, but they are just scattered around after an attack.
Flower that grows at the edge of cliffs. It is said to make wishes come true.
Flower grown from faerie magic, said to contain a bit of the fey spirit within.
Mushroom solid as rock. Must be roasted for days before softened enough to eat. It is therefore a rare delicacy and delicious.
It prevents faeries from losing consciousness.
Famous mushroom of Darkquaver Woods. It is traded at a high price.
Ore from the Croskurn Mines containing unique and powerful energy.
A rare plant grown only in the Valley of Death.
A mushroom that grew on the nutrients from the blood of the victims who fell from the bridge.
Stolen garrison food supply.
Marker necklace from a soldier tortured to death by Killian.
A red crystal emanating some bad energy. It resembles blood.
These spores are known to have a powerful sedative effect.
Fresh-laid basilisk egg is known as a delicacy.
An ice crystal that can be extracted from big bones.
Debris retrieved when destroying Mekonari's Bloodtomb Magic Stone.
A large fertile egg containing unhatched sikandari young. It feels warm.
Remains of an amani warrior who died in the Argon War.
A cold lump full of strong energy.
A small mineral shard that emits an endless, high-pitched but subdued sound.
A mysterious herb that emits a blueish phosphorescence. It has a bitter scent.
A device made of strange material. It looks like a natural ore lump rather than a component.
An ore with a natural flare pattern. Even separated from the ground, it still has some heat left.
A stone that emits a similar light to the light from a magical square.
Supplies of Devan brigands.
Journal of Sidurek. You cannot read because it is encrypted.
Fruit harvested from crops. It seems inedible.
All that remains of the kidnapped townsfolk.
A mysterious ore emanating a blueish phosphorescence.
A work of art found in the treasure box of the pirates.
Deserted timber from near the deserted house.
Supplies of the Kaidun army. It should help out the town.
A mysterious copy of the Core, source of the elves' power. It is yet unstable.
A bracelet marked with symbols of the evil god, Lok.
A tiny but beautiful blue flower.
A brief report from Basenius.
Creates a soothing agent. Found in the Azurice Shrine.
From yellow xanthic stones Found in the Azurice Shrine.
A potent energy source. Found in the Azurice Shrine.
For mining practice. Looks worthless.
Much stronger weapon than those used by the federation.
A potion with a crimson glow.
Yellowish-brown mushroom with coppery shine. It has a very sharp odor.
A blue Star Flower with a unique scent. It provides strong resistance against poison.
A crystal with a deep red hue as if it was solid blood.
A beautiful flower with mysterious energy. It's also used as an ingredient for medicine.
A fragment from an eldritch stone in the Celestial Hills. It hums audibly.
Its fragrance is sweet but there's hidden danger in its sweet scent. When the flower is fully bloomed, the aroma can induce headaches.
Medal awarded to the champions of the Valkyon Federation.
Bone pile that seems to be of an aman.
Protective stone created to protect the Goddess's garden. The stone is shattered.

Skill Advancement 15 (1 Hour)

[EN] A specialized booster item that accelerates your class progression.

[ES] Un objeto potenciador especializado que acelera la progresión de tu clase.

[Effect]
• Increases the Skill Advancement XP earned by 15% for 1 hour.
• Time decreases even when you're offline.

[Efecto]
• Aumenta la EXP de Avance de Habilidades obtenida en un 15% durante 1 hora.
• El tiempo disminuye incluso cuando estás desconectado.

[Usage]
Right-click in your inventory to activate the buff.

[Uso]
Haz clic derecho en tu inventario para activar el beneficio.

[Warning]
• Untradeable (Cannot be traded to other players or stored in Guild Bank).

[Advertencia]
• Intransferible (No se puede comerciar con otros jugadores ni guardar en el Banco del Gremio).

Big Breasts - Set of 3

[EN] A cosmetic modification bundle that alters your character's body proportions. Contains 3 pills.

[ES] Un paquete de modificación cosmética que altera las proporciones del cuerpo de tu personaje. Contiene 3 pastillas.

[Usage]
Right-click to consume. The effect lasts for an unlimited time.

[Uso]
Haz clic derecho para consumir. El efecto dura por tiempo ilimitado.

[Warning]
• Only applies to female characters.
• The effect is permanently canceled if you use a Sex Change or Race Change service.
• Untradeable (Cannot be traded to other players or stored in Guild Bank).

[Advertencia]
• Solo se aplica a personajes femeninos.
• El efecto se cancela permanentemente si usas un servicio de Cambio de Sexo o Cambio de Raza.
• Intransferible (No se puede comerciar con otros jugadores ni guardar en el Banco del Gremio).

Big Head Tablet (1 Day) Box

[EN] A fun cosmetic bundle containing tablets that temporarily alter your character's proportions.

[ES] Un divertido paquete cosmético que contiene pastillas que alteran temporalmente las proporciones de tu personaje.

[Contents]
• Big Head (1 Day) - Enlarges your character's head.
• Normal Head (1 Day) - Reverts your body to its original state.

[Contenido]
• Cabeza Grande (1 Día) - Agranda la cabeza de tu personaje.
• Cabeza Normal (1 Día) - Devuelve tu cuerpo a su estado original.

[Usage]
Right-click to open the box, then right-click the tablet in your inventory to apply the effect.

[Uso]
Haz clic derecho para abrir la caja, luego haz clic derecho en la pastilla en tu inventario para aplicar el efecto.

[Warning]
• Requires character level 1 or above.
• Untradeable (Cannot be traded to other players or stored in Guild Bank).
• Cooldown: 3 seconds.

[Advertencia]
• Requiere nivel de personaje 1 o superior.
• Intransferible (No se puede comerciar con otros jugadores ni guardar en el Banco del Gremio).
• Tiempo de reutilización: 3 segundos.

Body Modification Pill Box

[EN] A cosmetic bundle containing exotic pills that alter your character's body proportions.

[ES] Un paquete cosmético que contiene pastillas exóticas que alteran las proporciones del cuerpo de tu personaje.

[Contents]
• Thick Thighs (3) - Allows you to thicken or thin your thighs.
• Tall Body (3) - Allows you to lengthen or shorten your height.

[Contenido]
• Muslos Gruesos (3) - Te permite engrosar o adelgazar tus muslos.
• Cuerpo Alto (3) - Te permite alargar o acortar tu altura.

[Usage]
Right-click to open the box, then right-click the individual pills to select and apply your desired proportions. The effect lasts for an unlimited time.

[Uso]
Haz clic derecho para abrir la caja, luego haz clic derecho en las pastillas individuales para seleccionar y aplicar las proporciones deseadas. El efecto dura por tiempo ilimitado.

[Warning]
• Requires character level 1 or above.
• The effect is permanently canceled if you use a Sex Change or Race Change service.
• Untradeable (Cannot be traded to other players or stored in Guild Bank).

[Advertencia]
• Requiere nivel de personaje 1 o superior.
• El efecto se cancela permanentemente si usas un servicio de Cambio de Sexo o Cambio de Raza.
• Intransferible (No se puede comerciar con otros jugadores ni guardar en el Banco del Gremio).

Giant & Dwarf Candy Box

[EN] A fun cosmetic bundle containing magical candies to temporarily change your character's overall size.

[ES] Un divertido paquete cosmético que contiene dulces mágicos para cambiar temporalmente el tamaño general de tu personaje.

[Contents]
• Small Body 20 tablets box (Yields 20x Dwarf Candy / Small Body pills)
• Big Body 20 tablets box (Yields 20x Giant Candy / Tall Body pills)

[Contenido]
• Caja de 20 pastillas Cuerpo Pequeño (Otorga 20x Dulce Enano / Pastillas de Cuerpo Pequeño)
• Caja de 20 pastillas Cuerpo Grande (Otorga 20x Dulce Gigante / Pastillas de Cuerpo Alto)

[Effect & Usage]
• Eat a candy to shrink or grow larger for 10 minutes.
• The size effect can be stacked up to 3 times (maximum +3 or minimum -3).
• Right-click the candies in your inventory to apply the effect.

[Efecto y Uso]
• Come un dulce para encoger o crecer durante 10 minutos.
• El efecto de tamaño se puede acumular hasta 3 veces (máximo +3 o mínimo -3).
• Haz clic derecho en los dulces en tu inventario para aplicar el efecto.

[Warning]
• Entering combat cancels the size change effect immediately!
• Untradeable (Cannot be traded to other players or stored in Guild Bank).

[Advertencia]
• ¡Entrar en combate cancela el efecto de cambio de tamaño inmediatamente!
• Intransferible (No se puede comerciar con otros jugadores ni guardar en el Banco del Gremio).

Renaming Coupon

[EN] A special service voucher that allows you to change your character's name.

[ES] Un vale de servicio especial que te permite cambiar el nombre de tu personaje.

[Usage]
Right-click in your inventory to open the character name change interface.

[Uso]
Haz clic derecho en tu inventario para abrir la interfaz de cambio de nombre de personaje.

[Warning]
• The new name must comply with server naming rules.
• Untradeable (Cannot be traded to other players or stored in Guild Bank).

[Advertencia]
• El nuevo nombre debe cumplir con las reglas de nombres del servidor.
• Intransferible (No se puede comerciar con otros jugadores ni guardar en el Banco del Gremio).

[Mystery] Noctenium Infusion Box (~1000)

[EN] A mystery combat supply bundle that yields a random amount of Noctenium Infusions (around 1,000). Essential for end-game PvE and PvP combat.

[ES] Un misterioso paquete de suministros de combate que otorga una cantidad aleatoria de Infusiones de Noctenio (alrededor de 1,000). Esencial para el combate PvE y PvP en el juego final.

[Effect]
• Temporarily improves skills, producing different bonus effects depending on your class and skill type.

[Efecto]
• Mejora temporalmente las habilidades, produciendo diferentes efectos de bonificación dependiendo de tu clase y tipo de habilidad.

[Usage]
Right-click to open the box and receive your infusions. Right-click the infusion icon in your inventory or skill bar to toggle the effect on or off during combat.

[Uso]
Haz clic derecho para abrir la caja y recibir tus infusiones. Haz clic derecho en el ícono de infusión en tu inventario o barra de habilidades para activar o desactivar el efecto durante el combate.

[Warning]
• Requires character level 30 or above.
• Untradeable (Cannot be traded to other players or stored in Guild Bank).

[Advertencia]
• Requiere nivel de personaje 30 o superior.
• Intransferible (No se puede comerciar con otros jugadores ni guardar en el Banco del Gremio).

2013 Midnight Maillot

[EN] A smartbox containing a stylish black one-piece swimsuit from the 2013 summer collection.

[ES] Una caja inteligente que contiene un elegante traje de baño negro de una pieza de la colección de verano de 2013.

[Usage]
Right-click to open and receive a swimsuit tailored to your character's race and gender.

[Uso]
Haz clic derecho para abrir y recibir un traje de baño adaptado a la raza y género de tu personaje.

[Warning]
• Untradeable (Cannot be traded to other players or stored in Guild Bank).

[Advertencia]
• Intransferible (No se puede comerciar con otros jugadores ni guardar en el Banco del Gremio).

Converts an Ambush/Deathwrack weapon into a Behemoth/Oblit weapon of the same type. The Ambush/Deathwrack weapon is destroyed, but its enchantment effects, masterwork or awakened status, permanent etchings, and any currently equipped Dyad crystals will be transferred to the Behemoth/Oblit weapon. Non-equipped Dyad crystals bound to the Ambush/Deathwrack weapon will not function in the new item. The resulting Behemoth/Oblit weapon cannot be traded.
[To use, right-click on the fang and left-click on the target weapon.]

Converts an Ambush/Deathwrack body armor into a Behemoth/Oblit body armor of the same type. The Ambush/Deathwrack body armor is destroyed, but its enchantment effects, masterwork or awakened status, permanent etchings, and any currently equipped Dyad crystals will be transferred to the Behemoth/Oblit armor. Non-equipped Dyad crystals bound to the Ambush/Deathwrack armor will not function in the new item. The resulting Behemoth/Oblit armor cannot be traded.
[To use, right-click on the fang and left-click on the target armor.]

Converts an Ambush/Deathwrack handwear into a Behemoth/Oblit handwear of the same type. The Ambush/Deathwrack handwear is destroyed, but its enchantment effects, masterwork or awakened status, permanent etchings, and any currently equipped Dyad crystals will be transferred to the Behemoth/Oblit handwear. The resulting Behemoth/Oblit handwear cannot be traded.
[To use, right-click on the fang and left-click on the target handwear.]

Converts an Ambush/Deathwrack footwear into a Behemoth/Oblit footwear of the same type. The Ambush/Deathwrack footwear is destroyed, but its enchantment effects, masterwork or awakened status, permanent etchings, and any currently equipped Dyad crystals will be transferred to the Behemoth/Oblit footwear. The resulting Behemoth/Oblit footwear cannot be traded.
[To use, right-click on the fang and left-click on the target footwear.]

Summon NPC: Phargo

[EN] Instantly summons Phargo, a personal banker, to your current location.

[ES] Invoca instantáneamente a Phargo, un banquero personal, a tu ubicación actual.

[Effect]
• The banker remains available for 5 minutes after summoning.

[Efecto]
• El banquero permanece disponible durante 5 minutos después de ser invocado.

[Usage]
Right-click in your inventory to summon the NPC.

[Uso]
Haz clic derecho en tu inventario para invocar al NPC.

[Warning]
• Untradeable (Cannot be traded to other players or stored in Guild Bank).

[Advertencia]
• Intransferible (No se puede comerciar con otros jugadores ni guardar en el Banco del Gremio).

Complete Crystalbind

[EN] A premium protective scroll that guarantees your crystals will not break upon death.

[ES] Un pergamino protector premium que garantiza que tus cristales no se romperán al morir.

[Effect]
• Prevents crystals equipped on weapons and armor from being destroyed upon death. Lasts for 12 hours of in-game time. Replaces standard Crystalbind.

[Efecto]
• Evita que los cristales equipados en armas y armaduras sean destruidos al morir. Dura 12 horas de tiempo de juego. Reemplaza al Crystalbind estándar.

[Usage]
Right-click in your inventory to activate the buff.

[Uso]
Haz clic derecho en tu inventario para activar el beneficio.

[Warning]
• The buff persists through death and logging out.

[Advertencia]
• El beneficio persiste después de morir y cerrar sesión.

Skill Manual: Improved Flight Acceleration I

[EN] A training manual that permanently upgrades your flying mount's acceleration capabilities.

[ES] Un manual de entrenamiento que mejora permanentemente las capacidades de aceleración de tu montura voladora.

[Effect]
• Passively increases the acceleration speed of all your flying mounts (Level 1).

[Efecto]
• Aumenta pasivamente la velocidad de aceleración de todas tus monturas voladoras (Nivel 1).

[Usage]
Right-click in your inventory to learn the passive skill.

[Uso]
Haz clic derecho en tu inventario para aprender la habilidad pasiva.

[Warning]
• Requires a flying mount. Cannot be learned if you already have a higher level of this skill. Untradeable.

[Advertencia]
• Requiere una montura voladora. No se puede aprender si ya tienes un nivel superior de esta habilidad. Intransferible.

Use this manual to learn how to summon a Mighty Frost Monarch with a flying speed of 310 and a movement speed of 290. It restores 1% of your max MP and HP every second. Additionally you learn the passive skill Stormrage and the skill Stormcharge.

You can only benefit from the skills of one mighty flying mount at any one time. Only the effects of the last mount you summon apply.
You activate the skill by getting on your flying mount and pressing the left mouse button (default).

The Stormcharge skill can only be used after completing the [Important] Exodor Advance Base quest.

Use this manual to learn how to summon an Ancient Mighty Frost Monarch with a flying speed of 320 and a movement speed of 290. It restores 2% of your max MP and HP every second. Additionally you learn the passive skill Frostbane and the skill Stormcharge.

You can only benefit from the skills of one ancient mighty flying mount at any one time. Only the effects of the last mount you summon apply.
You activate the skill by getting on your flying mount and pressing the left mouse button (default).

The Stormcharge skill can only be used after completing the [Important] Exodor Advance Base quest.

Guild Name Voucher

[EN] A special voucher that allows the Guildmaster to change the name of their guild.

[ES] Un vale especial que permite al Maestro del Gremio cambiar el nombre de su gremio.

[Usage]
Right-click in your inventory to open the guild name change interface.

[Uso]
Haz clic derecho en tu inventario para abrir la interfaz de cambio de nombre del gremio.

[Warning]
• Can only be used by the Guildmaster.
• Untradeable (Cannot be traded to other players or stored in Guild Bank).

[Advertencia]
• Solo puede ser utilizado por el Maestro del Gremio.
• Intransferible (No se puede comerciar con otros jugadores ni guardar en el Banco del Gremio).

Converts an Ambush weapon into a Behemoth weapon of the same type. The Ambush weapon is destroyed, but its enchantment effects, masterwork or awakened status, permanent etchings, and any currently equipped Dyad crystals will be transferred to the Behemoth weapon. Non-equipped Dyad crystals bound to the Ambush weapon will not function in the new item. <font color = '#2478FF'>The resulting Behemoth weapon cannot be traded.

Converts a piece of Ambush body armor into Behemoth body armor of the same type. The Ambush armor is destroyed, but its enchantment effects, masterwork or awakened status, permanent etchings, and any currently equipped Dyad crystals will be transferred to the Behemoth armor. Non-equipped Dyad crystals bound to the Ambush armor will not function in the new item. <font color = '#2478FF'>The resulting Behemoth armor cannot be traded.

Converts a piece of Ambush handwear into Behemoth handwear of the same type. The Ambush handwear is destroyed, but its enchantment effects, masterwork or awakened status, and any permanent etchings will be transferred to the Behemoth handwear. <font color = '#2478FF'>The resulting Behemoth handwear cannot be traded.

Converts a piece of Ambush footwear into Behemoth footwear of the same type. The Ambush footwear is destroyed, but its enchantment effects, masterwork or awakened status, and any permanent etchings will be transferred to the Behemoth handwear. <font color = '#2478FF'>The resulting Behemoth footwear cannot be traded.

Pocket Tab

[EN] Unlocks the Pocket Tab feature for your character, providing a dedicated space for additional inventory slots.

[ES] Desbloquea la función Pestaña de Bolsillo para tu personaje, proporcionando un espacio dedicado para ranuras de inventario adicionales.

[Usage]
Right-click to consume and unlock the feature. Open your inventory and click the Pocket Tab icon at the top to access it.

[Uso]
Haz clic derecho para consumir y desbloquear la función. Abre tu inventario y haz clic en el ícono de la Pestaña de Bolsillo en la parte superior para acceder a ella.

[Warning]
• Do not use if your character has already unlocked this feature.
• Untradeable (Cannot be traded to other players or stored in Guild Bank).

[Advertencia]
• No lo uses si tu personaje ya ha desbloqueado esta función.
• Intransferible (No se puede comerciar con otros jugadores ni guardar en el Banco del Gremio).

You can only benefit from the skills of one mighty flying mount at any one time. Only the effects of the last mount you summon apply.

Hidden Weapon Sheath

[EN] A cosmetic skin item used to hide your weapon's appearance when equipped.

[ES] Un objeto de aspecto cosmético utilizado para ocultar la apariencia de tu arma cuando está equipada.

[Usage]
Right-click to equip in your character's [Weapon Costume Slot] under the Costumes tab.

[Uso]
Haz clic derecho para equipar en la [Ranura de Traje de Arma] de tu personaje en la pestaña de Trajes.

[Warning]
• Cosmetic item with no combat stats.
• Untradeable (Cannot be traded to other players or stored in Guild Bank).

[Advertencia]
• Objeto cosmético sin estadísticas de combate.
• Intransferible (No se puede comerciar con otros jugadores ni guardar en el Banco del Gremio).
Conceals the weapon on your back, for those times when subtlety is required...or you just want to show off your outfit.

Transparent Mask

[EN] A cosmetic skin item that hides any equipped face gear while revealing your character's natural face.

[ES] Un objeto de aspecto cosmético que oculta cualquier equipamiento facial equipado mientras revela el rostro natural de tu personaje.

[Usage]
Right-click to equip in your character's [Face Slot] under the Costumes tab.

[Uso]
Haz clic derecho para equipar en la [Ranura de Rostro] de tu personaje en la pestaña de Trajes.

[Warning]
• Cosmetic item with no combat stats.
• Untradeable (Cannot be traded to other players or stored in Guild Bank).

[Advertencia]
• Objeto cosmético sin estadísticas de combate.
• Intransferible (No se puede comerciar con otros jugadores ni guardar en el Banco del Gremio).
A mysterious mask that somehow also reveals your face underneath.

Use this manual to learn how to summon a Mighty Dusk Drake with a flying speed of 290 and a movement speed of 290. It restores 1% of your max MP and HP every second. Additionally you learn the passive skill Cursed Howl as well as the skill Corrupting Tide.

You can only benefit from the skills of one mighty flying mount at any one time. Only the effects of the last mount you summon apply.
You activate the skill by getting on your flying mount and pressing the left mouse button (default).

Right-click to equip in the [Style Info] > [Face] slot.

Pins your hair back, using the slot for facial adornments. Hides gear which is worn in the face slot.

Only for female characters.

Pinned-up Hairstyle (Face Slot)

[EN] Pins your hair back using the slot for facial adornments. Hides gear worn in the face slot.

[ES] Recoge tu cabello hacia atrás utilizando la ranura para adornos faciales. Oculta el equipo usado en la ranura del rostro.

[Usage]
Right-click to equip in your character's [Face Slot] under the Costumes tab. Only for female characters.

[Uso]
Haz clic derecho para equipar en la [Ranura de Rostro] de tu personaje en la pestaña de Trajes. Solo para personajes femeninos.

[Warning]
• Cosmetic item with no combat stats.
• Untradeable (Cannot be traded to other players or stored in Guild Bank).

[Advertencia]
• Objeto cosmético sin estadísticas de combate.
• Intransferible (No se puede comerciar con otros jugadores ni guardar en el Banco del Gremio).

Right-click to equip in the [Style Info] > [Head] slot.

Pins your hair back.

Only for female characters.

Pinned-up Hairstyle (Hair Slot)

[EN] A cosmetic hairstyle modification item that changes your character's hair appearance.

[ES] Un objeto de modificación de peinado cosmético que cambia la apariencia del cabello de tu personaje.

[Usage]
Right-click to equip in your character's [Hair Slot] under the Costumes tab.

[Uso]
Haz clic derecho para equipar en la [Ranura de Cabello] de tu personaje en la pestaña de Trajes.

[Warning]
• Cosmetic item with no combat stats.
• Untradeable (Cannot be traded to other players or stored in Guild Bank).

[Advertencia]
• Objeto cosmético sin estadísticas de combate.
• Intransferible (No se puede comerciar con otros jugadores ni guardar en el Banco del Gremio).

Super Speed Potion (100%-200%)

[EN] A volatile potion that dramatically boosts your movement speed.

[ES] Una poción volátil que aumenta dramáticamente tu velocidad de movimiento.

[Effect]
• Increases movement speed by a random amount between 100% and 200%.

[Efecto]
• Aumenta la velocidad de movimiento en una cantidad aleatoria entre el 100% y el 200%.

[Usage]
Right-click in your inventory to consume.

[Uso]
Haz clic derecho en tu inventario para consumir.

[Warning]
• Untradeable (Cannot be traded to other players).

[Advertencia]
• Intransferible (No se puede comerciar con otros jugadores).

Increases your hunting XP reward by $value for $time.$BRThe effect is doubled and the XP gain increased by 400% when a Monthly Pass has been used.$BRThis time decreases even when you're offline.$BR$BROnly one Super Speed Potion can be effective at a time. The effect may be doubled with a Rapid XP Potion.$BR$BR<font color = '#FF0000'>[Note]</font> If the Monthly Pass is used after consuming a potion, the potion's effect will not be doubled.

Increases your hunting XP reward by $value for $time.$BRThe effect is doubled and the XP gain increased by 600% when a Monthly Pass has been used.$BRThis time decreases even when you're offline.$BR$BROnly one Super Speed Potion can be effective at a time. The effect may be doubled with a Rapid XP Potion.$BR$BR<font color = '#FF0000'>[Note]</font> If the Monthly Pass is used after consuming a potion, the potion's effect will not be doubled.
Increases the Skill Advancement XP earned by the character by 15%. This time decreases even when you're offline.$BR$BRCan be used with Skill Advancement 5.

Adventure Coin (200)

[EN] A token required to enter dungeons. Restores 200 Adventure Coins upon use.

[ES] Una ficha necesaria para entrar a las mazmorras. Restaura 200 Monedas de Aventura al usarla.

[Usage]
Right-click the token in your inventory to instantly restore 200 Adventure Coins.

[Uso]
Haz clic derecho en la ficha de tu inventario para restaurar instantáneamente 200 Monedas de Aventura.

[Warning]
• Untradeable (Cannot be traded to other players or stored in Guild Bank).
• Can charge above your maximum limit, but cannot be used if your coins are already fully charged.
• Token Cooldown: 3 seconds.

[Advertencia]
• Intransferible (No se puede comerciar con otros jugadores ni guardar en el Banco del Gremio).
• Puede cargar por encima de tu límite máximo, pero no se puede usar si tus monedas ya están completamente cargadas.
• Tiempo de reutilización de la ficha: 3 segundos.

Use to open a shop, from which you can purchase Pet: Moon Bunny.

100% Reputation Boost (15 Days)

[EN] A highly sought-after booster that doubles the reputation you earn across Arborea.

[ES] Un potenciador muy codiciado que duplica la reputación que ganas en toda Arborea.

[Effect]
• Increases the amount of reputation points earned from Vanguard Requests and faction activities by +100% for 15 days.

[Efecto]
• Aumenta la cantidad de puntos de reputación obtenidos de las Solicitudes de Vanguardia y actividades de facción en un +100% durante 15 días.

[Usage]
Right-click in your inventory to activate the buff.

[Uso]
Haz clic derecho en tu inventario para activar el beneficio.

[Warning]
• Duration time continues to tick down even while offline.
• Untradeable (Cannot be traded to other players).

[Advertencia]
• El tiempo de duración sigue disminuyendo incluso estando desconectado.
• Intransferible (No se puede comerciar con otros jugadores).

Companion Appearance Change Voucher

[EN] A special service voucher used to transfer a companion's appearance to another companion while retaining its original combat abilities and level.

[ES] Un vale de servicio especial utilizado para transferir la apariencia de un compañero a otro manteniendo sus habilidades de combate y nivel originales.

[Usage]
Right-click the voucher to open the Companion Appearance interface. Select your target companion (to keep stats) and the target appearance companion, then confirm the transfer.

[Uso]
Haz clic derecho en el vale para abrir la interfaz de Apariencia de Compañero. Selecciona tu compañero objetivo (para mantener las estadísticas) y el compañero de apariencia objetivo, luego confirma la transferencia.

[Warning]
• Untradeable (Cannot be traded to other players or stored in Guild Bank).

[Advertencia]
• Intransferible (No se puede comerciar con otros jugadores ni guardar en el Banco del Gremio).
